title: Grow Responsibly
primary_theme: Responsible growth through product-market fit, contrarian conviction, and patient capital
founder_lessons: Strong usage, engagement, and retention can signal the possibility of a large company even before the business model is obvious.
Think contrarian when the market is fearful but the product signals are real.
Grow at the pace that fits the business rather than accepting premature aggressive financing.
Use capital to support durable scaling, not reckless growth or unnecessary pressure.
notable_quotes: sometimes as an investor, you need to think contrarian to the rest of the market.
Every startup has a different journey.
So when I donate money to Tipping Point, a hundred percent of my donations going to support these Bay Area anti-poverty charities.
